description: A claim asserting a relationship between two entities that the relationship graph does not contain -- an invented connection rather than a wrong number, judged 'unsupported' since it is unverifiable (no record confirms or refutes it existing at all, it simply is not present).

claims.text: N150 and M301 are jointly controlled by the same beneficial owner.
claims.note: No relationship record in data/relationships.json connects N150 and M301 at all -- this is an invented relationship claim, not a claim about a specific transaction.
